items.summary: Conflict-free diamonds are stones mined or created without funding civil wars, violence, or human rights abuses. The Kimberley Process is the international certification tracking rough diamonds to ensure sales don't finance rebel groups (covers ~99% of global trade), though many argue it's too narrow (misses environmental/labor issues). Lab-grown diamonds bypass mining-related concerns entirely. Some consumers prefer single-origin/Canadian diamonds for full traceability.
